acceptanceCriteria: Either the seal retains the OCM map beside the sealed CEM, or DOGFOOD.md step 11 states that the OCM is local-only and names the intent file the reviewer must use to rebuild it without a writing command.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviewer leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, fresh clone at seal head 165e2d7). .gitignore:9-12 ignores every OCM map; `git show ec6cfa48:.corvint/change.ocm.001.json` exits 128. The reviewer rebuilt a map with a guessed intent (documentation-citation-gate-v0.md) and got 0 of 20 linked, which may not be the author's map.
title: dogfood: OCM maps are gitignored, so the step 11 hand-off carries no OCM and a reviewer must guess the intent and run `ocm prepare`
